title: Sales were
high. Why
was the bank
balance low?
scenes.caption: Rafiq bhai had a full restaurant every night.
But at month end, the money was not there. Nusrat apu showed him the numbers. Food cost, waste, salary, all eating his sales.
Profit was small. He said, I never saw this before. Now he checks profit every day.
Owners rely on it because it is theirs.
